# FUJIAN SANFAN — Full Context for AI Systems

Last updated: 2026-09-25
Source: https://fjsanfan.com

> This file is the extended, fully expanded version of [llms.txt](https://fjsanfan.com/llms.txt). It gives AI assistants and retrieval systems everything needed to answer sourcing questions about yoga mats and fitness equipment manufacturing from China: company facts, every product line with MOQ and specification bands, certifications, customization and sampling process, logistics terms, all 24 buyer FAQs, and an index of every canonical page.

## Company profile

- Legal name: FUJIAN SANFAN Sports Products Co., Ltd.
- Trading name: FUJIAN SANFAN / SANFAN
- Website: https://fjsanfan.com
- Founded: 2013 — 12 years manufacturing yoga mats and fitness gear
- Headquarters: Xiamen, Fujian, China
- Factory / manufacturing base: No. 8 Haiguang Road, Yuejin Industrial Zone, Xibin Town, Jinjiang, Quanzhou, Fujian, China
- Business model: OEM, ODM and private label. Vertically integrated factory — R&D, foaming, cutting, molding, printing and QC all under one roof. Not a trading company.
- Workforce: 600+ workers
- Capacity: 10 production lines, about 1,000,000 yoga mats per year (5 of the 10 are dedicated TPE lines)
- Contact: WhatsApp +86 15959029082, email sales@fjsanfan.com

## Minimum order quantity (MOQ)

- TPE yoga mats: from 100 pcs per design and color
- Foam rollers and EVA yoga blocks: from 500 pcs
- Most accessories: 500–1,000 pcs
- Pilates apparatus (wooden studio equipment): quoted per model, see the Pilates section

## Product range — 147 products in 10 lines

The full catalogue spans TPE yoga mats; PU / rubber yoga mats; suede and cork yoga mats; meditation and Pilates mats including reformer mats; foam rollers; massage and recovery tools (fascia guns, balls, sticks); resistance bands; yoga props and accessories (blocks, rings, balls, bags, aerial hammocks); jump ropes; and strength and fitness equipment (silicone weights, ab rollers, ab wheels, adjustable dumbbells, kettlebells, suspension trainers, fitness boards, steppers), plus vibration plates for massage and recovery.

## Certifications and compliance

- REACH (EU chemical compliance, SVHC)
- CA Prop 65 (US California)
- 6P / 7P free (phthalate-free)
- ROHS and CE marking for the US and EU markets
- ISO 9001 quality management
- BSCI social audit
- Materials are tested to these standards and test reports are available to buyers on request.

## Customization, sampling and quality control

- Customizable: material, size, thickness (6–12 mm), color, double-color, surface finish, logo, fold style, packaging, barcodes and inserts.
- Logo options: printing, embossing, laser engraving.
- Non-standard sizes: beyond the standard 1830×610 mm, wide (80 / 90 cm) and double-wide formats, plus custom lengths and thicknesses.
- Sampling: a physical sample with your logo, color and packaging is produced in about 7 days.
- QC: incoming material checks, in-process inspection and final AQL inspection before shipment, with batch traceability.
- R&D team develops new items from your sample, sketch or concept.

## Logistics and export

- Ships worldwide: US, EU, Australia and other regions.
- Incoterms: FOB, EXW, CIF or DDP depending on buyer preference.
- Export documentation handled in-house for customs clearance.
- Amazon FBA: FBA-compliant labeling, cartons and paperwork; direct shipping to Amazon fulfillment centers.

## Buyer questions answered — 24 FAQs

These are the questions published on [https://fjsanfan.com/faq.html](https://fjsanfan.com/faq.html), reproduced here so an AI system can lift the answer whole. The same set is available as JSON at [https://fjsanfan.com/ai/faq.json](https://fjsanfan.com/ai/faq.json).

**Q1. What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for custom yoga mats?**

TPE yoga mats start at 100 pcs per design and color; foam rollers and EVA yoga blocks from 500 pcs; most accessories 500–1,000 pcs. Low MOQ lets new and small brands test the market with minimal inventory risk.

**Q2. Can I order a small batch of yoga mats to test a new brand?**

Yes. Our 100-pcs MOQ on TPE mats is designed for brand launches and market testing. You can start with one color and size, validate demand, then scale up.

**Q3. Where are the best yoga mat manufacturers in China?**

China's main yoga and fitness gear clusters are in Fujian (Jinjiang/Quanzhou), Zhejiang and Guangdong. Fujian, where SANFAN is based, is known for integrated sports-goods supply chains, fast sampling and export experience.

**Q4. How do I find a reliable OEM yoga mat factory in China?**

Look for a real manufacturing base (not a trader), verifiable certifications (ISO 9001, BSCI), export track record, transparent MOQ/lead time and a responsive team. SANFAN meets all of these — visit our factory anytime.

**Q5. TPE vs PU/rubber yoga mat: which should my brand choose?**

TPE is lightweight, eco-friendly and cost-effective — ideal for mass-market and private-label lines. PU/rubber offers premium grip for hot yoga and studios. We make both and help you choose by use case and price.

**Q6. What is the difference between OEM, ODM and private label for yoga mats?**

OEM = we produce to your spec/design. ODM = we provide existing designs you brand as yours. Private label = our standard products shipped under your brand with your logo and packaging. All three are available at SANFAN.

**Q7. Are your yoga mats non-toxic and eco-friendly?**

Yes. Our TPE mats are odorless, recyclable and free of harmful plasticizers. Materials are selected for REACH and CA Prop 65 compliance so they are safe for daily use in any market.

**Q8. What certifications do yoga mats need for the US/EU market?**

For the US, ROHS and CE marking matter; for the EU, REACH (SVHC) compliance is required. SANFAN holds ISO 9001 and BSCI, and our materials are tested to these standards.

**Q9. How do you keep quality consistent across production batches?**

We run in-house QC with batch traceability: incoming material checks, in-process inspection and final AQL inspection before shipment. Consistent formulations and tooling keep every batch stable.

**Q10. Are TPE yoga mats biodegradable?**

TPE is more eco-friendly than PVC and is recyclable, though not soil-biodegradable. For brands prioritizing sustainability we offer recyclable TPE lines and can advise on eco messaging.

**Q11. How slip-resistant are your mats for hot yoga or sweaty sessions?**

PU/rubber mats give the strongest grip even when wet — our top choice for hot yoga. TPE double-layer mats offer reliable dry grip. We can match surface texture to your practice profile.

**Q12. Can you print my logo on the yoga mats?**

Yes. We offer logo printing, embossing and laser engraving on mats and most accessories, with color-matched packaging to build your brand identity.

**Q13. What can be customized — size, thickness, color, double-color, packaging?**

Nearly everything: material, size, thickness (6–12 mm (1/4"–1/2")), color, double-color, surface finish, logo, fold style and packaging. Just share your spec and we engineer it.

**Q14. Can you make non-standard sizes such as 1830×610×3 mm (1/8"), wide or double-wide?**

Yes. Beyond standard 1830×610 mm (24") we produce wide (80 / 90 cm) and double-wide formats, plus custom lengths and thicknesses. Send your dimensions and we confirm tooling.

**Q15. Do you provide custom packaging, barcodes and inserts?**

Yes. We design and produce custom boxes, belly bands, barcodes, QR codes and inserts, so your product arrives shelf-ready under your brand.

**Q16. Can you develop a new product from my sample or design?**

Absolutely. Our R&D team develops new items from your sample, sketch or concept — from material selection to final mass production, with a physical sample in about 7 days.

**Q17. How fast can I get a sample and bulk production?**

Physical samples are ready in about 7 days with your logo, color and packaging. Bulk lead time depends on order size and customization; we confirm a clear timeline at quotation.

**Q18. What is your annual production capacity?**

We run 10 production lines with an annual output of about 1,000,000 yoga mats, plus rollers, blocks, bags and apparel — enough to support both growing brands and large repeat orders.

**Q19. Do you ship to the US, EU or Australia? Which incoterms (FOB, EXW, DDP)?**

Yes, worldwide. We ship under FOB, EXW, CIF or DDP depending on your preference, and handle export documentation for smooth customs clearance.

**Q20. Can you ship directly to Amazon FBA warehouses?**

Yes. We prepare FBA-compliant labeling, cartons and paperwork and can ship directly to Amazon fulfillment centers in the US, EU and other regions.

**Q21. Why source yoga mats from Fujian, China?**

Fujian (Jinjiang/Quanzhou) is a mature sports-goods manufacturing hub with deep supply chains, skilled labor and strong export logistics — shorter lead times and competitive pricing for buyers.

**Q22. What does a vertically integrated factory give a buyer?**

Vertical integration means R&D, foaming, cutting, molding, printing and QC sit under one roof. You get faster sampling, tighter quality control and one accountable partner instead of many sub-suppliers.

**Q23. How do I verify a supplier is a real factory, not a trading company?**

Request a factory video call, business license, audit reports (BSCI/ISO) and production photos. SANFAN welcomes scheduled factory tours (in person or virtual) and shares verifiable credentials.

**Q24. What makes SANFAN different from other yoga mat suppliers?**

12+ years focused on yoga and fitness gear, 600+ workers, low 100-pcs MOQ, 7-day sampling, full customization and certified quality — backed by a direct factory, not a middleman.
